name: Presents
overview: Scripture reveals that presents held significant value in ancient times, often symbolizing respect, friendship, and important agreements. For example, Abimelech gave Abraham livestock and servants as a sign of goodwill and restoration, while Abraham's gift of seven ewe lambs served as a witness to a covenant regarding a well. The detailed account of gifts such as golden earrings and bracelets given to Rebekah illustrates the ceremonial and personal nature of presenting valuable items, often conveyed on camels and bestowed with great care and significance.
